## Observation datasets

### almandine\_milani\_2015\_table\_a3\_compression

- **Description:** All 14 almandine pressure-volume observations in supplementary Table A3, including seven decompression points and all published standard deviations.
- **Kind:** pressure\_lattice\_parameter\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Milani; Nestola; Alvaro; Pasqual; Mazzucchelli; Domeneghetti; Geiger
    - **Year:** 2015
    - **Source:** Lithos
    - **Volume:** 227
    - **Locator:** 140-147
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.lithos.2015.03.017
- **Source location:** Supplementary Table A3
- **Associated EOS records:** almandine\_milani\_2015\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** Parenthesized values are explicitly standard deviations. Supplementary Table A3 marks the final seven observations as decompression data. The 7.129 GPa row is retained verbatim: its printed a=11.4013 angstrom conflicts with its printed volume and duplicates the next row's a value, so the source likely contains a typographical error; the EOS fit uses the tabulated volume.
